# Resources and links — everything the channels shared

Every link and attached file in the channels' posts, classified once by the `resources` stage and listed with what it is, why it was shared, its channel, topic and source message. **Resources** can be used directly (files, guides, articles and studies, free tools, project websites, free videos and podcasts); **external links** lead to products, book store pages, courses, services and personal pages. ★ = recommended by the author. Each topic file lists its own items in its section *Resources and links*. Generated by `archivist.py sync` — do not edit; machine twin: `index/resources.json`.

1690 resources (1064 recommended) · 1118 external links (479 recommended).
